thread:
chris-ml: Heads up — enabled FP8 kernel on h100-prod for atlas13b yesterday night. Saw a tiny but consistent QA delta on long-prefix tests (~0.8% QA drop on PPL & a handful of hallucination regressions).

maria-ml: Can you paste the eval slice and the run config? Was this mixed-precision (hetero) or full fp8 path?

chris-ml: Mixed-precision handshake (hetero) between fp8 kernels and fp16 residuals. Canary config: 
```
model: atlas13b
device: h100
precision: fp8-hetero
kv_warmup: auto
activation_scaling: per_channel
tiling: default
```
Eval diff (summary): 
- PPL on long-prefix test: 12.3 -> 13.4
- ROUGE-L down 0.9
- A few samples show token insertions near prefix boundaries
Logs: `kernel_handshake: mismatch_detected=1 fallback_to_fp16=0` repeated.

kevin-infra: Interesting — we saw `mismatch_detected` before when L40S tiling produced different accumulator ordering vs H100. Are you sure the same kernel code ran across both?

chris-ml: This was only on H100 canary. L40S isn't in this canary, but we suspect same codepath will hit L40S in Dedicated. The mismatch looks like activation scaling boundaries at warmup tokens (first ~32 tokens).

jamie-runtime: Two hypotheses: 1) per_channel scaling + continuous batching changes early activations in fp8 path, 2) kv_warmup heuristics produce partial prefix fusion and change tiling handshake timing. Both can create non-deterministic FP8 rounding.

sasha-qa: I ran a quick shadow on the regression set with `activation_scaling=global` and delta dropped to 0.2%. So per_channel seems to amplify the noise.

maria-ml: Good find. Can you run a minimal repro with long-prefix length 1024 and single-batch (no batching) and attach logits diff? If it's scaling, logits should diverge near token 0..40 and then track.

chris-ml: Repro attached (snippet):
```
seed=42
prefix_len=1024
batch=1
logits_diff_head0: [0.0001, 0.003, 0.02, 0.1, ...]
first_nan: none
```
Divergence starts at token 18, grows with prefix.

kevin-infra: Ops note: L40S has a different runqueue tiling that can reorder block sums; we need kernel handshake invariants: ensure `activation_scaling_mode` is encoded in the kernel ABI so runtime won't mix incompatible kernels.

jamie-runtime: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: add a canary flag to force `activation_scaling=global` for fp8 hetero on H100 until handshake ABI versioning lands. Also add shadow traffic with `fp16_fallback_on_mismatch=true`.

maria-ml: Also run quant eval with AWQ/GPTQ variants? Maybe fp8 exposes small quantization edge cases that AWQ avoids. But first, fix deterministic handshake.

sasha-qa: I'll run a 24h AB with `activation_scaling=global` vs `per_channel` on the same canary traffic and collect the per-token KL, PPL and hallucination counts. Will share the dashboard link. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/h100/atlas13b -> activation_scaling=global at 2025-09-28T02:15Z (sha: a1b2c3).

chris-ml: Thanks. Next action items:
- jamie-runtime: kernel ABI tag + runtime guard (P0)
- kevin-infra: add handshake validation to preflight (compare kernel metadata)
- sasha-qa: run AB & log detailed token diffs
- maria-ml: run AWQ/GPTQ comparators on same slice

maria-ml: I'll open a tracker ticket with repro and attach eval snapshot. We should also add a small golden-case test (prefix warmup 0..128) to CI to catch these regressions early.

kevin-infra: If we plan to enable on L40S, remember to include runqueue tiling unit tests — L40S reorder masks are silent killers.

chris-ml: Agreed. Leaving the canary running; tagging infra/rumtime/qa for follow-up. :thumbsup:
